correctness.rationale: All group-action geometric fixed points are correctly parametrized by edge-orbit barycenters with supported orbits forming matchings. Vertical edge orbits fail since mirrored vertical edges share their center-row endpoint. Horizontal orbits split by row type; under reversal the allowed left-index count is q=n/2 for even n or q=(n−3)/2 for odd n, and within each type only consecutive representatives conflict. Hence the full fixed space is PL homeomorphic to Ind(P_q disjoint-union P_q), including the empty n=3 case. A two-cone cover establishes Ind(P_q) ≃ Σ Ind(P_{q−3}) and yields the complete integral sphere/point classification. The independent verifier constructed group edge orbits for widths 2–90, explicitly tested face compatibility up to 13 and mod-two homology up to 12; finite calculations support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural and complete classification of the common geometric fixed loci of the two canonical grid reflections across every width. It upgrades scalar symmetry characters and quotient Euler counts to an explicit PL structure and full integral homotopy type, including periodic empty/contractible/spherical behavior and unbounded odd sphere dimension. The ambient matching complex is (n−2)-connected while common fixed spheres appear in lower dimensions, giving a concrete equivariant topology contrast. The contribution is modest but mathematical rather than a renaming or an arbitrary numerical slice.
